address: 5F, Mandarin Oriental, Bangkok, 48 Soi Charoen Krung 40, Charoen Krung Road, Bang Rak, Bangkok, 10500, Thailand
bio: Set in an elegant space adorned with handcrafted chandeliers and breathtaking river views, Le Normandie has been Bangkok's premier destination for haute cuisine for over 60 years. Now led by a renowned British chef who began his career in New York, the restaurant continues to impress. Innovative techniques and a modern interpretation of classic French dishes ensure the sophisticated dining experience lives on....
